message: This UPDATE rewrites every row of "assets", in one statement.
why: A whole-table UPDATE locks every row it changes until the migration commits, so writes to those rows wait, and it writes a new version of each row. On a large table that takes long and leaves the table bloated until VACUUM.
safeAlternative: Check that the change is intended, and whether down() needs to restore the old values. On a large table, update in batches, for example by ranges of the primary key, outside the migration's transaction.

message: "assets"."stackParentId" is dropped, which deletes every value in it.
why: Dropping a column deletes its data immediately. Application code that still reads or writes the column fails until every running instance has the new version.
safeAlternative: Remove the property from the entity and deploy that first. Drop the column in a later release, then suppress this finding with a reason.
